completed_missions.title: Build persistent 11-agent Hixton swarm
completed_missions.result: Eleven role contracts, persistent knowledge, regression protocol and GitHub-hosted cloud orchestration were established. Legacy laptop-bound engineering launchers and local agent runners were removed.

active_mission.title: USDC 3x80 early-loss-path improvement
active_mission.objective: Use the full cloud swarm to diagnose and improve the fresh USDC 3x80 portfolio path that reaches the early drawdown halt. Seek robust signal/strategy/execution improvements with time-separated validation; do not simply disable risk protection or optimize to one historical number.
constraints: Run in GitHub-hosted virtual environments; no owner laptop dependency.
Never send real or testnet exchange orders and never request Binance credentials.
Do not weaken the 5 percent daily loss pause or 20 percent drawdown halt merely to improve historical performance.
Do not relabel a fresh-start result as continuation of the older USDT account path.
Do not activate new strategy or risk parameters without a separate explicit owner activation decision.
Keep failed candidates, losing windows and contradictory evidence visible.
acceptance: All eleven roles participate or explicitly report not applicable with evidence.
Same-window USDT/USDC and fresh-start versus carried-account differences remain correctly separated.
A02 and A08 identify the concrete early-loss contributors and test bounded improvement hypotheses without data leakage.
A03 verifies Paper/portfolio behavior remains consistent for equivalent assumptions.
A04 verifies UI/report provenance remains current after any patch.
A05 and A06 check runtime and cross-component regressions.
Deterministic Python/UI QA passes on a fresh GitHub runner.
A09 issues QA_PASS and A11 issues GOVERNANCE_PASS before a pull request is opened.
No automatic merge or active-strategy activation occurs.
